lines: {target}? Dry cliffs make every mistake echo.
If anyone heads for Badlands, tell them. Carry water and watch the ledges.
Red sand and terracotta do not soften a fall.
So that is what Badlands is like. I am glad you made it back.
I will remember Badlands as hard country with old color in its bones.
For Badlands, I would carry rubble for fill and dressed stone for the places taking weight.
Any shelter at Badlands should be easy to find and even easier to leave.
